name: Iron Shaft
summary: Near Felwood, the Iron Shaft waits in a locked chest. It is one piece of Dartol's Rod, sought by Teronis to slow the furbolg assaults on Ashenvale.

sections.title: A Piece of Dartol's Rod
sections.body: Dartol made the rod, then its pieces were scattered across Ashenvale. One was placed in the care of the druids of Dor'Danil. The Iron Shaft is the rod's sturdy metal core, kept in a locked chest in a glade near Ashenvale's northern border, close to Felwood.

sections.title: The Forest's Blight
sections.body: The key to the Iron Shaft's chest lies with treants that once tended these woods. Demonic corruption from Felwood has driven the Crazed and Withered Ancients mad. Shael'dryn, a dryad, asks travelers to recover the shaft so Dartol's Rod can be reforged and Teronis's work completed.

faq.q: What is the Iron Shaft used for?
aliases: why do i need iron shaft
faq.answer: The Iron Shaft is one piece of the broken Dartol's Rod. Shael'dryn seeks the pieces so the rod can be reassembled and Teronis's effort to slow the furbolg assaults on Ashenvale can be completed.

faq.q: Where is the Iron Shaft found?
faq.answer: The Iron Shaft lies in a locked chest in a glade west of the road toward Felwood, in northern Ashenvale.

faq.q: How do you open the chest containing the shaft?
faq.answer: A Wooden Key opens the chest. The corrupted Crazed and Withered Ancients carry it as they wander the woods northeast of Raynewood Retreat.

faq.q: Who is looking for the Iron Shaft?
faq.answer: Shael'dryn, a dryad at a moonwell in central Ashenvale, directs travelers to gather Dartol's Rod's pieces to help cleanse the forest.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, recovering the Iron Shaft means putting down forest treants you hold dear, corrupted by the demonic blight seeping from Felwood.
As a druid, reassembling Dartol's Rod calls on your duty to tend the land and use forgotten tools to heal it.
